neighbours.label: a rule setting an upper limit on a quantity: strongest on 'maximum' after 'sets the', and in 'fixes the price' or 'only so many'
fire: A rent ceiling sets the maximum rent owners may collect.
This cap sets the maximum fee banks are allowed to charge.
The decree sets the maximum interest lenders may ask.
Regulators fix the highest fare taxis can charge.
There are only so many seats on the bus.
In that region, the city fixes the price of water.
The licence sets the maximum number of guests allowed.
The tariff sets the maximum price of electricity.
quiet: A rent survey shows the average sum owners collect.
This chart compares the usual fee banks charge.
The decree lists the names of approved lenders.
Regulators review the fare data every year.
There are many empty seats on the bus.
In that region, the city sells water to farms.
The licence shows the name of the owner.
The tariff table gives the history of electricity.

short: a rule sets an upper limit
notes: One top example (-11.75) stands well above the rest (under 5). Other constraint phrasings reached only 0.1-0.2 in probing, so this may fail the median. The + pole is about constraints themselves (promotes constraint, restrictions).
